coreFeatures.title: Core Features
coreFeatures.rdoText: Generate complete PDF reports right from the site. Weather, personnel, activities, and photo galleries integrated.
coreFeatures.financeText: Control budgets, expenses, and transactions. Know exactly where every cent was invested.
coreFeatures.portalText: Give your clients access to view schedules and download photo packages (limited and controlled by you).
coreFeatures.whiteLabelText: Generate PDFs with your logo on the header and a custom footer. 100% professional appearance.

coreFeatures.syncText: Available on Web, Windows, Android, and iOS. What you do on one device, instantly updates on the others.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: Does my client pay to use the app?
faq.a1: No, client access is completely free and controlled by the permissions in your plan.
faq.q2: Can I use it on computer and mobile?
faq.a2: Yes! Obra Fácil is responsive and works both in your PC browser and on your smartphone at the site.
faq.a3: Absolutely. We use the most modern cloud infrastructures and end-to-end encryption to ensure code security.
faq.a4: We only collect what's necessary to create your account: Name, Document ID, Email, and Phone, in full GDPR compliance.
faq.a5: The app temporarily saves information in your phone's memory (cache). Once the connection is restored, data synchronizes to the cloud automatically.
faq.q6: Does my client lose access to files if the project ends?
faq.a6: If the project is 70% or more complete, the client gets a 15-day Grace Period to download everything before access goes away.
faq.q7: Does Obra Fácil replace a professional Engineer?
faq.a7: No. The app is an amazing management tool, but it does not replace technical professional oversight.
faq.q8: Can I delete my account and all my data?
faq.a8: Yes, you have the right to be forgotten. Upon requesting account deletion, all your data, photos, and PDFs are permanently removed.
faq.q9: I'm on the PRO plan and added extra storage. Can I cancel?
faq.a9: Yes. You can cancel subscriptions anytime to stop billing for the next cycle, keeping access until the paid period ends.
faq.q10: What happens if a monthly payment is late?
faq.a10: The system pauses the creation of new projects and file uploads, but you won't lose existing data as long as you regularize the payment.
